title: Preserve exact authored bend offsets
scope: Preserve GPIF bend offsets that the current integer 0..12 public scale rounds away, while keeping an explicit edit contract for existing callers.
acceptance: A valid 35% GPIF offset remains 35% after public import, edit and GP8 export; include a fractional percentage such as 35.5 because pinned AlphaTab also retains fractional offsets on its 0..60 scale.
Preserve endpoints and two distinct middle offsets in source control-role order, with representable quarter-tone values; compare exact wire values and independent consumer offsets.

Define one authority between any exact offset representation and the existing Position field. Existing binary positions and post-parse caller edits must have documented, tested conversions without silent rounding.

Reject non-finite and out-of-range authored offsets before narrowing; retain precise reports for genuinely unsupported shapes and metadata. Update field, enum, wire and source-dispatch obligations for the changed contract.
exclusions: No invented BendStyle or per-point vibrato wire fields. More than four controls, incompatible middle values, and non-quarter-tone heights remain separate target/oracle limits.
Do not claim an integer 0..60 scale is exact for every GPIF float. Whammy integration is #72; nonmonotonic control-role validation is #62.

reproduction.instructions: A valid 35% GPIF offset remains 35% after public import, edit and GP8 export; include a fractional percentage such as 35.5 because pinned AlphaTab also retains fractional offsets on its 0..60 scale. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
implementation-ready: Confirmed 0..12 rounding in gpifBendPosition and binary conversion. Pinned _toBendOffset multiplies by 0.6 without integer truncation, so fractional offsets also matter.
